   55:     reg  [63:0] mux_data;
   56: 
   57:     // =======================================================
   58:     // 3. OUTPUT WIRES (Connecting Scrambler -> LPC)
   59:     // =======================================================
   60:     wire        scr_dv;
   61:     wire [63:0] scr_data;
   62:     
   63:     wire        lpc_dv;
   64:     wire [95:0] lpc_data;
   65: 
   66:     // Loopback Self-Check Wires (lpc_dec_top -> descrambler)
   67:     wire        rx_lpc_dec_dv;
   68:     wire [63:0] rx_lpc_dec_data;
   69:     wire        rx_desc_dv;
   70:     wire [63:0] rx_desc_data;
   71: 
   72:     // =======================================================
   73:     // 4. WAVEFORM TRACKERS (For Visual Proof to ETRI)
   74:     // =======================================================
   75:     reg  [31:0] frame_type_str; // Displays "DAT1", "DAT2", "IDLE", "MGMT"
   76:     
   77:     // Input Trackers (From FEC_MUX)
   78:     reg  [8:0]  in_mux_word_idx; // 1 to 259 Words
   79:     reg  [11:0] in_mux_byte_idx; // 8 to 2072 Bytes
   80:     
   81:     // Scrambler Output Trackers
   82:     reg  [8:0]  out_scr_word_idx; // 1 to 259 Words
   83:     reg  [11:0] out_scr_byte_idx; // 8 to 2072 Bytes
   84:     
   85:     // LPC Output Trackers (Final FEC Core Output)
   86:     reg  [8:0]  out_lpc_word_idx; // 1 to 259 Words
   87:     reg  [11:0] out_lpc_byte_idx; // 12 to 3108 Bytes (96-bit = 12 Bytes!)
   88: 
   89:     // [Rev 2.0] Hierarchical Probes for ETRI Audit Item 4 (25-bit PRBS) & Item 6 (Disparity)
   90:     wire [24:0]        scr_state_25b     = u_scrambler.Q;
   91:     wire [63:0]        scr_prbs_mask_64b = u_scrambler.S;
   92:     wire signed [11:0] lpc3_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_3.running_disparity;
   93:     wire signed [11:0] lpc2_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_2.running_disparity;
   94:     wire signed [11:0] lpc1_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_1.running_disparity;
   95:     wire signed [11:0] lpc0_running_disp = u_lpc_top.lpc_0.running_disparity;
   96: 
   97:     // =======================================================
   98:     // 5. DUT INSTANTIATIONS
   99:     // =======================================================
  100:     
  101:     // A. Scrambler (64-bit, 259 cycles, 25-bit PRBS Seed 25'h0000007)
  102:     scrambler u_scrambler (
  103:         .clk      (clk),
  104:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  105:         .en       (mux_dv),
  106:         .data_in  (mux_data),
  107:         .flag     (scr_dv),
  108:         .data_out (scr_data)
  109:     );
  110: 
  111:     // B. LPC Encoder Top (64-bit to 96-bit expansion, 259 cycles + Active Disparity)
  112:     lpc_top u_lpc_top (
  113:         .clk      (clk),
  114:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  115:         .en       (scr_dv),
  116:         .data_in  (scr_data),
  117:         .flag     (lpc_dv),
  118:         .data_out (lpc_data)
  119:     );
  120: 
  121:     // C. [Rev 2.0] Loopback Self-Checker: LPC Decoder Top + 25-bit Descrambler
  122:     lpc_dec_top u_rx_lpc_dec_top (
  123:         .clk      (clk),
  124:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  125:         .en       (lpc_dv),
  126:         .data_in  (lpc_data),
  127:         .flag     (rx_lpc_dec_dv),
  128:         .data_out (rx_lpc_dec_data)
  129:     );
  130: 
  131:     descrambler u_rx_descrambler (
  132:         .clk      (clk),
  133:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  134:         .en       (rx_lpc_dec_dv),
  135:         .data_in  (rx_lpc_dec_data),
  136:         .flag     (rx_desc_dv),
  137:         .data_out (rx_desc_data)
  138:     );
  139: 
  140:     // =======================================================
  141:     // 6. CLOCK GENERATION (200 MHz -> 5.0 ns)
  142:     // =======================================================
  143:     initial begin
  144:         clk = 1'b0;
  145:         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk;
  146:     end
  147: 
  148:     // =======================================================
  149:     // 7. CONTINUOUS 4-FRAME GENERATOR FSM
  150:     // =======================================================
  151:     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd0;
  152:     localparam ST_GAP    = 2'd1;
  153:     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;
  154: 
  155:     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
  156:     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  157:     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  158: 
  159:     initial begin
  160:         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  161:         tb_state  = ST_STREAM;
  162:         frame_id  = 4'd1;
  163:         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
  164:         #100;
  165:         rst_n     = 1'b1;
  166:     end
  167: 
  168:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  169:         if (!rst_n) begin
  170:             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  171:             frame_id  <= 4'd1;
  172:             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  173:         end else begin
  174:             case (tb_state)
  175:                 ST_STREAM: begin
  176:                     // FEC_MUX outputs exactly 259 words per frame
  177:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd259) begin
  178:                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  179:                     end else begin
  180:                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  181:                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  182:                     end
  183:                 end
  184:                 
  185:                 ST_GAP: begin
  186:                     // Short inter-frame gap to show Scrambler & LPC resetting cleanly
  187:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd15) begin
  188:                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  189:                     end else begin
  190:                         if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  191:                             frame_id  <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  192:                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  193:                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  194:                         end else begin
  195:                             tb_state  <= ST_DONE;
  196:                         end
  197:                     end
  198:                 end
  199:                 
  200:                 ST_DONE: begin
  201:                     tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  202:                 end
  203:             endcase
  204:         end
  205:     end
  206: 
  207:     // =======================================================
  208:     // 8. DATA PATTERNS & TRACKER LOGIC
  209:     // =======================================================
  210:     always @(*) begin
  211:         mux_dv   = 1'b0;
  212:         mux_data = 64'd0;
  213: 
  214:         if (rst_n && (tb_state == ST_STREAM)) begin
  215:             mux_dv = 1'b1;
  216:             
  217:             // Cycles 1 to 2: Original 16-Byte Header
  218:             if (cycle_cnt == 16'd1)      mux_data = {4'd0, frame_id, 8'h00, 16'h0000, 8'hFD, 24'h554433};
  219:             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd2) mux_data = 64'h2211_F28A_8899_0F28;
  220:             // Cycles 3 to 4: 16-Byte Header RS Parity
  221:             else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd4) mux_data = 64'hC1C2_C1C2_C1C2_C1C2;
  222:             // Cycle 5: Payload Start (Table 2-18 FSO Payload & Packet Headers)
  223:             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd5) mux_data = (frame_id == 4'd2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
  224:             // Cycle 243: Payload End (CRC-32)
  225:             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd243) mux_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + {60'd0, frame_id};
  226:             // Cycles 244 to 259: 16-Word (128-Byte) Payload RS Parity
  227:             else if (cycle_cnt > 16'd243)  mux_data = 64'hB10C_B10C_B10C_B10C;
  228:             // Cycles 6 to 242: Main Payload Body
  229:             else begin
  230:                 if (frame_id == 4'd1 || frame_id == 4'd2) mux_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A;
  231:                 else if (frame_id == 4'd3)                mux_data = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E;
  232:                 else                                      mux_data = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1;
  233:             end
  234:         end
  235:     end
  236: 
  237:     // String Indicator for Waveform
  238:     always @(*) begin
  239:         if (!rst_n || tb_state == ST_DONE) frame_type_str = "DONE";
  240:         else if (tb_state == ST_GAP)       frame_type_str = "GAP ";
  241:         else begin
  242:             case (frame_id)
  243:                 4'd1: frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  244:                 4'd2: frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  245:                 4'd3: frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  246:                 4'd4: frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  247:                 default: frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  248:             endcase
  249:         end
  250:     end
  251: 
  252:     // [Rev 2.4] Exact FIFO Reference Queue for Loopback Self-Check (1036 Words)
  253:     reg [63:0] ref_queue [0:2047];
  254:     integer    ref_wr_ptr      = 0;
  255:     integer    ref_rd_ptr      = 0;
  256:     integer    loopback_ok_cnt = 0;
  257:     integer    loopback_err_cnt = 0;
  258: 
  259:     // Byte & Word Counters for Waveform
  260:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  261:         if (!rst_n) begin
  262:             in_mux_word_idx  <= 9'd0;
  263:             in_mux_byte_idx  <= 12'd0;
  264:             out_scr_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  265:             out_scr_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  266:             out_lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  267:             out_lpc_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  268:             ref_wr_ptr       <= 0;
  269:             ref_rd_ptr       <= 0;
  270:             loopback_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  271:             loopback_err_cnt <= 0;
  272:         end else begin
  273:             // Record every accepted TX input word into Reference Queue
  274:             if (mux_dv) begin
  275:                 ref_queue[ref_wr_ptr] <= mux_data;
  276:                 ref_wr_ptr            <= ref_wr_ptr + 1;
  277:             end
  278: 
  279:             // Verify every recovered RX Descrambled word against Reference Queue
  280:             if (rx_desc_dv) begin
  281:                 if (rx_desc_data === ref_queue[ref_rd_ptr])
  282:                     loopback_ok_cnt <= loopback_ok_cnt + 1;
  283:                 else
  284:                     loopback_err_cnt <= loopback_err_cnt + 1;
  285:                 ref_rd_ptr <= ref_rd_ptr + 1;
  286:             end
  287: 
  288:             // Track Input from MUX
  289:             if (mux_dv) begin
  290:                 in_mux_word_idx <= in_mux_word_idx + 1'b1;
  291:                 in_mux_byte_idx <= in_mux_byte_idx + 12'd8;
  292:             end else begin
  293:                 in_mux_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  294:                 in_mux_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  295:             end
  296: 
  297:             // Track Scrambler Output
  298:             if (scr_dv) begin
  299:                 if (out_scr_word_idx == 9'd0) begin
  300:                     $display(" [%0t] Frame %0d Scrambler Word 1: State Q = 25'h%07X (Seed=0x0000007) | PRBS Mask S = 0x%016X",
  301:                              $time, frame_id, scr_state_25b, scr_prbs_mask_64b);
  302:                 end
  303:                 out_scr_word_idx <= out_scr_word_idx + 1'b1;
  304:                 out_scr_byte_idx <= out_scr_byte_idx + 12'd8;
  305:             end else begin
  306:                 out_scr_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  307:                 out_scr_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  308:             end
  309: 
  310:             // Track LPC Output (96-bit = 12 Bytes per cycle!)
  311:             if (lpc_dv) begin
  312:                 out_lpc_word_idx <= out_lpc_word_idx + 1'b1;
  313:                 out_lpc_byte_idx <= out_lpc_byte_idx + 12'd12;
  314:             end else begin
  315:                 out_lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  316:                 out_lpc_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  317:             end
  318:         end
  319:     end
  320: 
  321:     // Simulation Termination
  322:     initial begin
  323:         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  324:         wait(loopback_ok_cnt + loopback_err_cnt == 1036);
  325:         #200;
  326:         $display("\n=======================================================");
  327:         $display(" SCRAMBLER (25-BIT SEED 0x0000007) & LPC(24,16) REPORT");
  328:         $display("=======================================================");
  329:         $display(" Scrambler aligned to 259-cycle processing (25-bit PRBS).");
  330:         $display(" LPC expanded 64-bit words to 96-bit structures with Active Disparity.");
  331:         $display(" Final output profile : 259 Words (3108 Bytes) per frame.");
  332:         $display(" Loopback Verified    : %0d / 1036 Words Matched (Errors: %0d)", loopback_ok_cnt, loopback_err_cnt);
  333:         if (loopback_ok_cnt == 1036 && loopback_err_cnt == 0)
  334:             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 4 & ITEM 6!");
  335:         else
  336:             $fatal(1, " RESULT: [FAIL] Mismatches detected in Scrambler/LPC loopback!");
  337:         $display("=======================================================\n");
  338:         $finish;
  339:     end

   47:     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;
   48:     reg  [11:0] in_byte_cnt;

   50:     always @(*) begin
   51:         case (demux_frame_id)

   53:             32'd2:   frame_type_str = "DAT2";
   54:             32'd3:   frame_type_str = "IDLE";
   55:             32'd4:   frame_type_str = "MGMT";
   56:             default: frame_type_str = "WAIT";
   57:         endcase
   58:     end

   68:         .lpc_data_out(lpc_data_out),
   69:         .lpc_valid_out(lpc_valid_out)
   70:     );
   71: 
   72:     // 2. Initiation Preamble Checker ([Rev 2.0] Fixed module name to preamble_sda_decoder)
   73:     preamble_sda_decoder u_checker (

   88:                 12'd2:   get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;

   95:                 12'd9:   get_frame_byte = 8'h26;
   96:                 12'd10:  get_frame_byte = 8'hAB;
   97:                 12'd13:  get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
   98:                 12'd3117:get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
   99:                 default: begin
  100:                     if      (f_idx <= 32'd2) get_frame_byte = 8'hDA;
  101:                     else if (f_idx == 32'd3) get_frame_byte = 8'h1D;
  102:                     else                     get_frame_byte = 8'hA1;
  103:                 end
  104:             endcase
  105:         end
  106:     endfunction
  107: 
  108:     integer i, k, abs_b;
  109:     reg [127:0] word128_tmp;
  110:     integer lpc_out_cnt = 0;
  111: 
  112:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  113:         if (preamble_valid) begin
  114:             $display(" [%0t] Preamble Extracted = 0x%018X (Expected: 0x77AD5B5843641E2E26)",
  115:                      $time, preamble_extracted);
  116:         end

  119:         end

  135:         // ------ SCENARIO 1 & 2: FLOW FLOW 4 FRAMES (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT = 780 Word 128-bit / 12,468 Byte) ---
  136:         // The first word contains {72'h77_AD_5B_58_84_64_1_1_2E_2E_26, 56-bit LPC Initial data} in MSB [127:56]
  137:         for (i = 0; i < 780; i = i + 1) begin
  138:             for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  139:                 abs_b = i * 16 + k;
  140:                 if (abs_b < 12468)

  152:         // Finish transmission

  154:         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b0;
  155:         cdc_data_in  <= 128'd0;
  156:         in_clk_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  157:         in_byte_cnt  <= 12'd0;

  160:         wait(lpc_out_cnt == 1036);

  164:         $display(" -> Extracted Preamble : 0x%018X", preamble_extracted);
  165:         $display(" -> Link Locked Status : %0b (Locked Frames: %0d / 4)", link_locked, locked_frame_cnt);
  166:         $display(" -> Contiguous LPC Out : %0d Words (%0d Bytes, Expected: 1036 Words / 12432B)",

  169:             (link_locked == 1'b1) && (lpc_out_cnt == 1036))
  170:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH SDA OISL TABLE 2-8!");
  171:         $display("=======================================================\n");

  102:     // Zero-Initialized Table 2-15 CRC-16 (x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1)
  103:     function [15:0] step_crc16(input [15:0] q, input [7:0] d);
  104:         reg [15:0] nxt;
  105:         begin
  106:             nxt[0]  = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ q[8]  ^ q[12];
  107:             nxt[1]  = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ q[9]  ^ q[13];
  108:             nxt[2]  = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ q[10] ^ q[14];
  109:             nxt[3]  = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  110:             nxt[4]  = d[4] ^ q[12];
  111:             nxt[5]  = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ d[5] ^ q[8]  ^ q[12] ^ q[13];
  112:             nxt[6]  = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ d[6] ^ q[9]  ^ q[13] ^ q[14];
  113:             nxt[7]  = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ d[7] ^ q[10] ^ q[14] ^ q[15];
  114:             nxt[8]  = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[0]  ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  115:             nxt[9]  = d[4] ^ q[1]  ^ q[12];
  116:             nxt[10] = d[5] ^ q[2]  ^ q[13];
  117:             nxt[11] = d[6] ^ q[3]  ^ q[14];
  118:             nxt[12] = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ d[7] ^ q[4]  ^ q[8]  ^ q[12] ^ q[15];
  119:             nxt[13] = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ q[5]  ^ q[9]  ^ q[13];
  120:             nxt[14] = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ q[6]  ^ q[10] ^ q[14];
  121:             nxt[15] = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[7]  ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  122:             step_crc16 = nxt;
  123:         end
  124:     endfunction
  125: 
  126:     // Zero-Initialized Table 2-15 CRC-32 (0x04C11DB7)
  127:     function [31:0] step_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
  128:         reg [31:0] v;
  129:         integer k;
  130:         begin
  131:             v = c ^ d;
  132:             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
  133:                 if (v[31]) v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
  134:                 else       v = (v << 1);
  135:             end
  136:             step_crc32 = v;
  137:         end
  138:     endfunction
  139: 
  140:     // Table 2-14 LSB-First Telemetry Vector (Matches mgmt_telemetry_generator.v)
  141:     wire [255:0] mgmt_lsb_vec = {
  142:         27'd0, 1'b1, 40'd0, 32'd1476000000,
  143:         64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000, 40'd0, 6'd15,
  144:         40'd16678204759, 6'd15
  145:     };

  147:     task send_fso_frame(
  148:         input [15:0] txfn,
  149:         input [1:0]  ftype,
  150:         input        corrupt_pld_crc
  151:     );
  152:         integer idx;
  153:         reg [7:0]  hb;
  154:         reg [15:0] crc16_acc;
  155:         reg [31:0] pw;
  156:         reg [31:0] crc32_acc;
  157:         begin
  158:             crc16_acc = 16'd0;
  159:             crc32_acc = 32'd0;
  160: 
  161:             for (idx = 0; idx < 478; idx = idx + 1) begin
  162:                 // 1. 16-Byte Header on Cycles 0..15
  163:                 if (idx < 14) begin
  164:                     case (idx)
  165:                         0:  hb = txfn[7:0];
  166:                         1:  hb = txfn[15:8];
  167:                         2:  hb = 8'h01;
  168:                         3:  hb = 8'h00;
  169:                         4:  hb = {4'b1111, 1'b1, 1'b1, ftype};
  170:                         10: hb = {2'b11, 6'd15};
  171:                         11: hb = {1'b1, 3'b000, 4'hA};
  172:                         12: hb = 8'h01;
  173:                         13: hb = 8'hF0;
  174:                         default: hb = 8'h55;
  175:                     endcase
  176:                     crc16_acc = step_crc16(crc16_acc, hb);
  177:                 end else if (idx == 14) begin
  178:                     hb = crc16_acc[15:8];
  179:                 end else if (idx == 15) begin
  180:                     hb = crc16_acc[7:0];
  181:                 end else begin
  182:                     hb = 8'd0;
  183:                 end
  184: 
  185:                 // 2. 478-Word Payload (477 Data Words + 478th Word CRC-32)
  186:                 if (idx < 477) begin
  187:                     if (ftype == 2'b10) begin
  188:                         // MGMT Frame (Table 2-14 LSB-first)
  189:                         if (idx < 8) pw = mgmt_lsb_vec[(idx * 32) +: 32];
  190:                         else         pw = 32'd0;
  191:                     end else if (ftype == 2'b00) begin
  192:                         // IDLE Frame
  193:                         pw = 32'h1D1E_0000 + idx[31:0];
  194:                     end else begin
  195:                         // DATA Frame (Table 2-18)
  196:                         if      (idx == 0) pw = (txfn == 16'd2) ? 32'hAB00_4064 : 32'hAB00_0000;
  197:                         else if (idx == 1) pw = (txfn == 16'd2) ? 32'hAAAA_0001 : 32'hCDEF_07D0;
  198:                         else               pw = {txfn, idx[15:0]};
  199:                     end
  200:                     crc32_acc = step_crc32(crc32_acc, pw);
  201:                 end else begin
  202:                     pw = corrupt_pld_crc ? (crc32_acc ^ 32'hDEAD_DEAD) : crc32_acc;
  203:                 end
  204: 
  205:                 @(posedge clk);
  206:                 s_axis_hdr_tvalid <= (idx < 16);
  207:                 s_axis_hdr_tdata  <= (idx < 16) ? hb : 8'd0;
  208:                 s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  209:                 s_axis_fso_tdata  <= pw;
  210:             end
  211: 
  212:             @(posedge clk);
  213:             s_axis_hdr_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  214:             s_axis_hdr_tdata  <= 8'd0;
  215:             s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  216:             s_axis_fso_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  217:             repeat (25) @(posedge clk);
  218:         end
  219:     endtask
  220: 
  221:     integer drained_data_frames = 0;
  222:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  223:         if (local_fb_ack_valid) begin
  224:             $display(" [%0t] ARQ Feedback Generated -> RXFN=%0d | ACK=%0b (%s)",
  225:                      $time, local_fb_rxfn, local_fb_ack, local_fb_ack ? "ACK" : "NAK");

  230:                      $time, drained_data_frames + 1, expected_txfn);

  237:         s_axis_hdr_tdata  = 8'd0;

  260:         send_fso_frame(16'd2, 2'b01, 1'b0);

  269:         $display("======================================================================\n");

   22:        - Frame 1 (Start Frame, 478 words = 1912B):
   23:          * Word 0 = 32'hAB00_0000 (seq_num=0, Length=0)
   24:          * Word 1 = 32'hCDEF_07D0 (Magic=0xCDEF, Length=2000 Bytes)
   25:        - Frame 2 (Continuation Frame, 478 words = 1912B):
   26:          * Word 0 = 32'hAB00_4064 (seq_num=1, Length=100 Bytes remaining)
   27:          * Words 1..25 = 100 Bytes remaining Ethernet payload (ending with 
   28:            FCS 32'hDEADBEEF at Word 25, NO duplicate 0xCDEF Packet Header!)
   29:          * Words 26..476 = 1804 Bytes (451 words) Zero Padding
   30:          * Word 477 = 4-Byte FSO CRC-32
   31:     3. Added ARQ DDR4 Retransmit readback test (ddr4_read_req = 1) to verify 
   32:        Target B3.2 (all 478 words = 1912 Bytes including Word 477 CRC-32 are 
   33:        stored and re-emitted intact).
   34:   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : [Unified Counter & Frame Label Alignment]
   35:     1. Preserved all original descriptions, section headers, and Rev 1.0/2.0 logs.
   36:     2. Connected 'seg_valid_bytes' input port on u_fso_payload (Rev 2.1 dynamic length).
   37:     3. Added standardized waveform counters: frame_id, frame_type_str ("DAT1", 
   38:        "DAT2", "RETX"), in_clk_cnt (1..475), in_byte_cnt (4..1900), out_clk_cnt 
   39:        (1..478), and out_byte_cnt (4..1912).
   40:   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Exact Completion Wait Synchronization]
   41:     Replaced fixed '#2000' delays before Frame 1 and Frame 2 console reporting with 
   42:     event-driven 'wait(rx_frame_idx == 2'd1)' and 'wait(rx_frame_idx == 2'd2)' so the
   43:     testbench waits for the 500-word Store-and-Segment FIFO lookahead plus all 478 words
   44:     (1912 Bytes including Word 477 CRC-32) of Frame 1 and Frame 2 to complete.
   45: ===========================================================================
   46: */
   47: 
   48: module tb_fso_payload();

  104:     reg         ddr4_read_req;

  110:     wire        fifo_data_tvalid;
  111:     wire        fifo_data_tlast;
  112:     reg         fifo_data_tready;

  117:     wire        retx_data_tlast;
  118:     reg         retx_data_tready;

  121:         .clk                 (clk),
  122:         .rst_n               (rst_n),
  123:

  125:         .s_axis_eth_tvalid   (seg_tvalid),
  126:         .s_axis_eth_tlast    (seg_tlast),
  127:         .s_axis_eth_tready   (seg_tready),
  128:         .seg_valid_bytes     (seg_valid_bytes),
  129:

  131:         .ddr4_read_req       (ddr4_read_req),
  132:         .ddr4_delete_req     (ddr4_delete_req),
  133:         .ddr4_addr           (ddr4_addr),
  134: 
  135:         .m_axis_data_tdata   (fifo_data_tdata),
  136:         .m_axis_data_tvalid  (fifo_data_tvalid),
  137:         .m_axis_data_tlast   (fifo_data_tlast),
  138:         .m_axis_data_tready  (fifo_data_tready),
  139: 
  140:         .m_axis_retx_tdata   (retx_data_tdata),
  141:         .m_axis_retx_tvalid  (retx_data_tvalid),
  142:         .m_axis_retx_tlast   (retx_data_tlast),
  143:         .m_axis_retx_tready  (retx_data_tready)
  144:     );
  145: 
  146:     // =======================================================
  147:     // SYSTEM CLOCK GENERATOR: 312.5 MHz (3.2ns period)
  148:     // =======================================================
  149:     initial begin
  150:         clk = 1'b0;
  151:         forever #1.6 clk = ~clk; 
  152:     end
  153: 
  154:     // =======================================================
  155:     // CYCLE COUNTER, TABLE 2-18 VERIFIER & DYNAMIC ARQ ADDRESS LOGIC
  156:     // =======================================================
  157:     reg [15:0] in_clk_cnt;       // 1..475 Clocks (1900B Segment In)
  158:     reg [15:0] in_byte_cnt;      // 4..1900 Bytes
  159:     reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;      // 1..478 Clocks (1912B FSO Payload Out)
  160:     reg [15:0] out_byte_cnt;     // 4..1912 Bytes
  161:     reg [15:0] payload_cycle_cnt;
  162:     reg [15:0] frame1_word_cnt;
  163:     reg [15:0] frame2_word_cnt;
  164:     reg [15:0] retx_word_cnt;
  165:     reg [31:0] f1_pld_hdr, f1_pkt_hdr, f1_crc32;
  166:     reg [31:0] f2_pld_hdr, f2_word1_data, f2_word25_fcs, f2_crc32;
  167:     reg [31:0] retx_last_word_crc32;
  168:     reg [1:0]  rx_frame_idx;
  169:     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  170:     reg [31:0] frame_type_str;
  171: 
  172:     always @(*) begin
  173:         if      (retx_data_tvalid)      begin frame_id = 4'd3; frame_type_str = "RETX"; end
  174:         else if (rx_frame_idx == 2'd0)  begin frame_id = 4'd1; frame_type_str = "DAT1"; end
  175:         else if (rx_frame_idx == 2'd1)  begin frame_id = 4'd2; frame_type_str = "DAT2"; end
  176:         else                            begin frame_id = 4'd0; frame_type_str = "DONE"; end
  177:     end
  178:     
  179:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  180:         if (!rst_n) begin
  181:             in_clk_cnt           <= 16'd0;
  182:             in_byte_cnt          <= 16'd0;
  183:             out_clk_cnt          <= 16'd0;
  184:             out_byte_cnt         <= 16'd0;
  185:             payload_cycle_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  186:             ddr4_addr            <= 16'd0; // Start storing at Address 0
  187:             frame1_word_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  188:             frame2_word_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  189:             retx_word_cnt        <= 16'd0;
  190:             f1_pld_hdr           <= 32'd0;
  191:             f1_pkt_hdr           <= 32'd0;
  192:             f1_crc32             <= 32'd0;
  193:             f2_pld_hdr           <= 32'd0;
  194:             f2_word1_data        <= 32'd0;
  195:             f2_word25_fcs        <= 32'd0;
  196:             f2_crc32             <= 32'd0;
  197:             retx_last_word_crc32 <= 32'd0;
  198:             rx_frame_idx         <= 2'd0;
  199:         end else begin
  200:             // Standardized Input Segment Counters (1..475 Clocks = 4..1900 Bytes)
  201:             if (seg_tvalid && seg_tready) begin
  202:                 if (seg_tlast || in_clk_cnt == 16'd475) begin
  203:                     in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  204:                     in_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  205:                 end else begin
  206:                     in_clk_cnt  <= in_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  207:                     in_byte_cnt <= in_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  208:                 end
  209:             end else if (!seg_tvalid) begin
  210:                 in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  211:                 in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  212:             end
  213: 
  214:             // Standardized Output FSO Payload Counters (1..478 Clocks = 4..1912 Bytes)
  215:             if (fifo_data_tvalid && fifo_data_tready) begin
  216:                 if (fifo_data_tlast || out_clk_cnt == 16'd478) begin
  217:                     out_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  218:                     out_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  219:                 end else begin
  220:                     out_clk_cnt  <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  221:                     out_byte_cnt <= out_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  222:                 end
  223:             end else begin
  224:                 out_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  225:                 out_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  226:             end
  227: 
  228:             // Keep ARQ sniffer write enabled at the start of each frame
  229:             if ((payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd0) && !u_fso_payload.u_arq_ddr4_wrapper.is_writing && (rx_frame_idx < 2'd2)) begin
  230:                 ddr4_write_req <= 1'b1;
  231:             end else begin
  232:                 ddr4_write_req <= 1'b0;
  233:             end
  234: 
  235:             if (u_fso_payload.crc_tvalid && u_fso_payload.crc_tready) begin
  236:                 if (rx_frame_idx == 2'd0) begin
  237:                     frame1_word_cnt <= frame1_word_cnt + 16'd1;
  238:                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd0)   f1_pld_hdr <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  239:                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd1)   f1_pkt_hdr <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  240:                     if (u_fso_payload.crc_tlast)      f1_crc32   <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  241:                 end else if (rx_frame_idx == 2'd1) begin
  242:                     frame2_word_cnt <= frame2_word_cnt + 16'd1;
  243:                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd0)   f2_pld_hdr    <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  244:                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd1)   f2_word1_data <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  245:                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd25)  f2_word25_fcs <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  246:                     if (u_fso_payload.crc_tlast)      f2_crc32      <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  247:                 end
  248: 
  249:                 if (u_fso_payload.crc_tlast) begin
  250:                     payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
  251:                     rx_frame_idx      <= rx_frame_idx + 2'd1;
  252:                     // Increment ARQ RAM address for the next frame
  253:                     ddr4_addr         <= ddr4_addr + 1'b1; 
  254:                 end else begin
  255:                     payload_cycle_cnt <= payload_cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  256:                 end
  257:             end
  258: 
  259:             // Track ARQ DDR4 Retransmit Readback (Target B3.2 Verification)
  260:             if (retx_data_tvalid && retx_data_tready) begin
  261:                 retx_word_cnt <= retx_word_cnt + 16'd1;
  262:                 if (retx_data_tlast) begin
  263:                     retx_last_word_crc32 <= retx_data_tdata;
  264:                 end
  265:             end
  266:         end
  267:     end
  268: 
  269:     // =======================================================
  270:     // SIMULATION SCENARIO
  271:     // =======================================================
  272:     initial begin
  273:         // 1. Initialization
  274:         rst_n             = 1'b0;
  275:         trigger           = 1'b0;
  276:         target_frame_size = 16'd2000; // Attack with 2000B Jumbo Frame
  277:         
  278:         // MUX is always ready to receive data
  279:         fifo_data_tready  = 1'b1; 
  280:         retx_data_tready  = 1'b1;
  281:         
  282:         // Configure ARQ Wrapper to sniff and write to RAM
  283:         ddr4_write_req    = 1'b1;  
  284:         ddr4_read_req     = 1'b0;
  285:         ddr4_delete_req   = 1'b0;
  286: 
  287:         #100;
  288:         rst_n = 1'b1;
  289:         #50;
  290:         
  291:         $display("\n[%0t] SCENARIO: PC Fires a 2000-Byte Jumbo Frame...", $time);
  292:         
  293:         // Fire Jumbo Packet
  294:         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b1; 
  295:         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b0; 
  296:         
  297:         // [Rev 2.4] Wait until all 478 words (1912 Bytes) of Frame 1 finish CRC-32 & RAM write
  298:         wait(rx_frame_idx == 2'd1);
  299:         @(posedge clk);
  300:         $display("[%0t] FRAME 1 Complete: %0d Words (%0d Bytes). Saved to DDR4 Addr 0.", $time, frame1_word_cnt, frame1_word_cnt * 4);
  301:         $display("       -> Word 0 (FSO Payload Hdr) : 0x%08X (Expected: 0xAB000000, seq=0, Len=0)", f1_pld_hdr);
  302:         $display("       -> Word 1 (FSO Packet Hdr)  : 0x%08X (Expected: 0xCDEF07D0, Len=2000B)", f1_pkt_hdr);
  303:         $display("       -> Word 477 (FSO CRC-32)    : 0x%08X", f1_crc32);
  304:         
  305:         // [Rev 2.4] Wait until all 478 words (1912 Bytes) of Frame 2 finish CRC-32 & RAM write
  306:         wait(rx_frame_idx == 2'd2);
  307:         @(posedge clk);
  308:         $display("[%0t] FRAME 2 Complete: %0d Words (%0d Bytes). Saved to DDR4 Addr 1.", $time, frame2_word_cnt, frame2_word_cnt * 4);
  309:         $display("       -> Word 0 (FSO Payload Hdr) : 0x%08X (Expected: 0xAB004064, seq=1, Cont_Len=100B)", f2_pld_hdr);
  310:         $display("       -> Word 1 (Cont Data Word 1): 0x%08X (No duplicate 0xCDEF per Table 2-18!)", f2_word1_data);
  311:         $display("       -> Word 25 (100th B Eth FCS): 0x%08X (Expected: 0xDEADBEEF)", f2_word25_fcs);
  312:         $display("       -> Word 477 (FSO CRC-32)    : 0x%08X", f2_crc32);
  313:         
  314:         // Verify ARQ DDR4 Retransmit Readback of Frame 1 (Slot 0) -> Must emit all 478 words (1912B)
  315:         @(posedge clk);
  316:         ddr4_write_req = 1'b0;
  317:         ddr4_addr      = 16'd0;
  318:         ddr4_read_req  = 1'b1;
  319:         @(posedge clk);
  320:         ddr4_read_req  = 1'b0;

  323:         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);
  324:         $display("[%0t] ARQ RETX READBACK Complete: %0d Words (%0d Bytes), Last Word CRC-32 = 0x%08X",
  325:                  $time, retx_word_cnt, retx_word_cnt * 4, retx_last_word_crc32);
  326:         if ((frame1_word_cnt == 16'd478) && (frame2_word_cnt == 16'd478) &&
  327:             (retx_word_cnt == 16'd478) && (retx_last_word_crc32 == f1_crc32) &&
  328:             (f1_pkt_hdr == 32'hCDEF_07D0) && (f2_pld_hdr == 32'hAB00_4064) &&
  329:             (f2_word25_fcs == 32'hDEAD_BEEF))
  330:             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] TABLE 2-18 CONTINUATION & 1912B ARQ RAM VERIFIED 100%%!\n");
  331:         else
  332:             $fatal(1, " RESULT: [FAIL] Frame word count or header mismatch!");
  333:         
  334:         $finish;
  335:     end

   35: module tb_x_gth_logic();
   36: 
   37:     // =======================================================
   38:     // 1. SYSTEM CLOCKS AND RESET
   39:     // =======================================================
   40:     reg clk_gth;   // Fast Write Domain Clock : 312.5 MHz (Period: 3.2 ns)
   41:     reg clk_logic; // Slow Read Domain Clock  : 200.0 MHz (Period: 5.0 ns)
   42:     reg rst_n;
   43: 
   44:     // =======================================================
   45:     // 2. DEVICE UNDER TEST (DUT) SIGNALS

   48:     reg  [7:0]  header_in;
   49:     reg         en_load;

   53:     wire        header_dv;
   54:     wire [7:0]  header_out;
   55:     wire        payload_dv;
   56:     wire [63:0] payload_out;
   57: 
   58:     // =======================================================
   59:     // 3. VISUALIZATION AND TRACKING VARIABLES (For Vivado)
   60:     // =======================================================
   61:     // ASCII String to dynamically display Frame Type (Set Radix to ASCII)
   62:     reg [31:0] mux_frame_type_str; 
   63: 
   64:     // Current Frame Tracker (1 to 4)
   65:     reg [3:0]  current_frame_id;
   66: 
   67:     // --- INPUT INDICES ---
   68:     // Sequential indices to drive data injection
   69:     reg [4:0]  header_byte_index;   // 0 (Idle), 1 to 16 (Active)
   70:     reg [15:0] payload_word_index;  // 0 (Idle), 1 to 478 (Active)
   71: 
   72:     // --- OUTPUT INDICES (WAVEFORM VISUALIZERS) ---
   73:     // Internal hidden registers
   74:     reg [4:0]  out_header_cnt_reg;
   75:     reg [7:0]  out_payload_cnt_reg;
   76: 
   77:     // Combinational wires for perfect waveform alignment (Starts at 1)
   78:     wire [4:0] out_header_byte_idx  = header_dv  ? (out_header_cnt_reg + 1'b1)  : 5'd0;
   79:     wire [7:0] out_payload_word_idx = payload_dv ? (out_payload_cnt_reg + 1'b1) : 8'd0;
   80: 
   81:     // Output Verification Counters (Cumulative for final check)
   82:     integer verified_header_bytes  = 0;
   83:     integer verified_payload_words = 0;
   84:     integer hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt  = 0;
   85:     integer pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt  = 0;
   86: 
   87:     // =======================================================
   88:     // 4. DUT INSTANTIATION
   89:     // =======================================================
   90:     x_gth_logic u_cdc_tx_1 (
   91:         .clk_gth    (clk_gth),
   92:         .clk_logic  (clk_logic),
   93:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   94:         .en_head    (en_head),
   95:         .en_load    (en_load),
   96:         .header_in  (header_in),
   97:         .payload_in (payload_in),
   98:         .cdc_ready  (cdc_ready),
   99:         .header_dv  (header_dv),
  100:         .header     (header_out),
  101:         .payload_dv (payload_dv),
  102:         .payload    (payload_out)
  103:     );
  104: 
  105:     // =======================================================
  106:     // 5. CLOCK GENERATION & OUTPUT TRACKING
  107:     // =======================================================
  108:     initial begin

  116:     end

  118:     // Sequential Tracker Logic for Outputs
  119:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  120:         if (!rst_n) begin
  121:             out_header_cnt_reg     <= 5'd0;
  122:             out_payload_cnt_reg    <= 8'd0;
  123:             verified_header_bytes  <= 0;
  124:             verified_payload_words <= 0;
  125:             hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  126:             pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt  <= 0;

  146:             end
  147:         end
  148:     end

  150:     // =======================================================
  151:     // 6. MAIN SCENARIO: TWO-PROCESS FSM ARCHITECTURE
  152:     // =======================================================
  153:     localparam ST_INIT   = 2'd0;
  154:     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd1;
  155:     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;

  174:                 end

  178:                     if (cdc_ready) begin

  180:                         // 1. Advance Payload Index (Max 478 Words)

  185:                             if (current_frame_id < 4) begin

  187:                                 current_frame_id   <= current_frame_id + 1'b1;
  188:                                 payload_word_index <= 16'd1;
  189:                                 header_byte_index  <= 5'd1;
  190:                             end else begin
  191:                                 // All 4 frames transmitted
  192:                                 tb_state           <= ST_DONE;
  193:                                 payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  194:                                 header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  195:                             end
  196:                         end
  197: 
  198:                         // 2. Advance Header Index (Max 16 Bytes)
  199:                         if (header_byte_index >= 1 && header_byte_index < 16) begin
  200:                             header_byte_index <= header_byte_index + 1'b1;
  201:                         end else if (header_byte_index == 16) begin
  202:                             // Park index to 0 after 16 bytes are sent
  203:                             header_byte_index <= 5'd0; 
  204:                         end
  205:                     end
  206:                 end
  207: 
  208:                 ST_DONE: begin
  209:                     // Keep indices parked
  210:                     header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  211:                     payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  212:                 end
  213:             endcase
  214:         end
  215:     end
  216: 
  217:     // --- PROCESS 2: COMBINATIONAL LOGIC (Data Injection) ---
  218:     always @(*) begin
  219:         // Default Assignments (Prevents Latches)
  220:         en_head            = 1'b0;
  221:         header_in          = 8'd0;
  222:         en_load            = 1'b0;
  223:         payload_in         = 32'd0;

  232:                 if      (current_frame_id == 1) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT1"; 
  233:                 else if (current_frame_id == 2) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT2"; 
  234:                 else if (current_frame_id == 3) mux_frame_type_str = "IDLE";

  237:                 // --- HEADER DATA MAPPING (Cycles 1 to 16 per Table 2-10) ---

  242:                         5'd2:  header_in = 8'h00;                       // d1: TXFN[15:8] (MSB)
  243:                         5'd15: header_in = 8'hC1;                       // d14: CRC-16 MSB
  244:                         5'd16: header_in = 8'hC2;                       // d15: CRC-16 LSB
  245:                         default: header_in = 8'hAA;                     // Dummy PNT/Config
  246:                     endcase
  247:                 end
  248: 
  249:                 // --- PAYLOAD DATA MAPPING (Cycles 1 to 478) ---
  250:                 if (payload_word_index >= 1 && payload_word_index <= 478) begin
  251:                     en_load = 1'b1;
  252:                     case (payload_word_index)
  253:                         16'd1:   payload_in = 32'hAB00_0000; // FSO Payload Header (Table 2-18)
  254:                         16'd2:   payload_in = 32'hCDEF_07D0; // FSO Packet Header (Len = 2000B)
  255:                         16'd478: payload_in = 32'hC3C3_C3C3; // FSO CRC-32 Tail

  259:                                 payload_in = 32'hDA7A_DA7A; // DATA Pattern
  260:                             else if (current_frame_id == 3)

  262:                             else                                
  263:                                 payload_in = 32'hA1A1_A1A1; // MGMT Pattern
  264:                         end
  265:                     endcase
  266:                 end

  268:             else begin
  269:                 // If CDC asserts Backpressure, freeze data (TREADY=0 behavior)
  270:                 mux_frame_type_str = "HOLD";
  271:             end
  272:         end 
  273:         else if (tb_state == ST_DONE) begin
  274:             mux_frame_type_str = "DONE";
  275:         end
  276:     end

    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : xgmii_rx_parser
    7: Description  : 32-bit IEEE 802.3ae XGMII Receive Frame Delimiter Parser.
    8:                Detects the XGMII Start control character (/S/ = 0xFB on Lane 0)
    9:                and Terminate control character (/T/ = 0xFD on any lane) to 
   10:                convert raw XGMII words into an AXI-Stream frame.
   11: 
   12:                Revision Notes:
   13:                - Preserved original XGMII /S/ (0xFB) and /T/ (0xFD) detection
   14:                  state machine.
   15:                - Standardized port interface (clk, rst_n, xgmii_rxd, xgmii_rxc,
   16:                  m_axis_tdata, m_axis_tvalid, m_axis_tlast) to match 
   17:                  eth_rx_front_end_top.v without port mismatch errors.
   18: - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F04 - Partial Terminal Word Preservation]
   19:     Preserved 100% of original ports and lookahead architecture. When Terminate (/T/)
   20:     occurs in lane 1, 2, or 3 (xgmii_rxc != 4'b0000 && xgmii_rxc[0] == 1'b0), the 1..3
   21:     valid Ethernet data bytes preceding /T/ are now flushed on the next cycle with 
   22:     m_axis_tlast = 1'b1 instead of being discarded.
   23: ===========================================================================
   24: */
   25: 
   26: module xgmii_rx_parser (
   27:     input  wire        clk,
   28:     input  wire        rst_n,
   29: 
   30:     // Physical / Loopback 32-bit XGMII Input
   31:     input  wire [31:0] xgmii_rxd,
   32:     input  wire [3:0]  xgmii_rxc,
   33: 
   34:     // Framed AXI-Stream Output (Includes 8B Ethernet Preamble)
   35:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   36:     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   37:     output reg         m_axis_tlast
   38: );
   39: 
   40:     reg        in_frame;
   41:     reg [31:0] prev_data;
   42:     reg        flush_tail_pending;
   43:     reg [31:0] tail_data_reg;
   44: 
   45:     wire is_start_word    = (xgmii_rxc == 4'b0001) && (xgmii_rxd[7:0] == 8'hFB);
   46:     wire is_data_word     = (xgmii_rxc == 4'b0000);
   47:     wire has_partial_tail = in_frame && (xgmii_rxc != 4'b0000) && (xgmii_rxc[0] == 1'b0);
   48: 
   49:     wire [31:0] masked_tail_word = {
   50:         xgmii_rxc[3] ? 8'h00 : xgmii_rxd[31:24],
   51:         xgmii_rxc[2] ? 8'h00 : xgmii_rxd[23:16],
   52:         xgmii_rxc[1] ? 8'h00 : xgmii_rxd[15:8],
   53:         xgmii_rxc[0] ? 8'h00 : xgmii_rxd[7:0]
   54:     };
   55: 
   56:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   57:         if (!rst_n) begin
   58:             in_frame           <= 1'b0;
   59:             prev_data          <= 32'd0;
   60:             flush_tail_pending <= 1'b0;
   61:             tail_data_reg      <= 32'd0;
   62:             m_axis_tdata       <= 32'd0;
   63:             m_axis_tvalid      <= 1'b0;
   64:             m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b0;
   65:         end else begin
   66:             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   67:             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   68: 
   69:             if (flush_tail_pending) begin
   70:                 m_axis_tdata       <= tail_data_reg;
   71:                 m_axis_tvalid      <= 1'b1;
   72:                 m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b1;
   73:                 flush_tail_pending <= 1'b0;
   74:             end
   75: 
   76:             if (!in_frame) begin
   77:                 if (is_start_word) begin
   78:                     in_frame  <= 1'b1;
   79:                     prev_data <= {xgmii_rxd[31:8], 8'h55};
   80:                 end
   81:             end else begin
   82:                 if (is_data_word) begin
   83:                     m_axis_tdata  <= prev_data;
   84:                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   85:                     m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   86:                     prev_data     <= xgmii_rxd;
   87:                 end else begin
   88:                     in_frame      <= 1'b0;
   89:                     m_axis_tdata  <= prev_data;
   90:                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   91:                     if (has_partial_tail) begin
   92:                         m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b0;
   93:                         flush_tail_pending <= 1'b1;
   94:                         tail_data_reg      <= masked_tail_word;
   95:                     end else begin
   96:                         m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b1;
   97:                     end
   98:                 end
   99:             end
  100:         end

   40:         end else begin

   42:                 S_IDLE: begin
   43:                     xgmii_txd     <= 32'h07070707; 
   44:                     xgmii_txc     <= 4'b1111;
   45:                     s_axis_tready <= 1'b0;
   46:                     if (s_axis_tvalid) state <= S_PREAMBLE_1;
   47:                 end
   48: 
   49:                 S_PREAMBLE_1: begin
   50:                     xgmii_txd     <= 32'h555555FB; // 0xFB strictly on lane 0
   51:                     xgmii_txc     <= 4'b0001; 
   52:                     state         <= S_PREAMBLE_2;
   53:                 end
   54: 
   55:                 S_PREAMBLE_2: begin
   56:                     xgmii_txd     <= 32'hD5555555; 
   57:                     xgmii_txc     <= 4'b0000;
   58:                     s_axis_tready <= 1'b1;         
   59:                     state         <= S_DATA;
   60:                 end
   61: 
   62:                 S_DATA: begin
   63:                     if (s_axis_tvalid) begin
   64:                         if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   65:                             s_axis_tready <= 1'b0; 
   66:                             case (s_axis_tkeep)
   67:                                 4'b0001: begin xgmii_txd <= {16'h0707, XGMII_TERM, s_axis_tdata[7:0]}; xgmii_txc <= 4'b1110; state <= S_IPG; end

   69:                                 4'b0111: begin xgmii_txd <= {XGMII_TERM, s_axis_tdata[23:0]}; xgmii_txc <= 4'b1000; state <= S_IPG; end
   70:                                 4'b1111: begin xgmii_txd <= s_axis_tdata; xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000; state <= S_TERM_EXT; end
   71:                             endcase
   72:                         end else begin
   73:                             xgmii_txd <= s_axis_tdata;
   74:                             xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   75:                         end
   76:                     end
   77:                 end
   78: 
   79:                 S_TERM_EXT: begin
   80:                     xgmii_txd <= {24'h070707, XGMII_TERM};
   81:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   82:                     state     <= S_IPG;
   83:                 end
   84: 
   85:                 S_IPG: begin
   86:                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h07070707;
   87:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   88:                     if (ipg_cnt == 2'd1) begin // Min 3 cycles (9.6 ns)
   89:                         ipg_cnt <= 2'd0;
   90:                         state   <= S_IDLE; 
   91:                     end else begin
   92:                         ipg_cnt <= ipg_cnt + 1'b1;
   93:                     end
   94:                 end
   95:             endcase
   96:         end
   97:     end

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : xgmii_tx_formatter
    7: Description  : IEEE 802.3ae 32-bit XGMII Transmit Formatter.
    8:                Converts the framed Ethernet stream (8-Byte Preamble + 
    9:                Payload + FCS) into physical XGMII data (xgmii_txd[31:0]) and 
   10:                control (xgmii_txc[3:0]) signals for eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0.
   11: 
   12:                KEY OPERATIONS:
   13:                1. Idle State:
   14:                   Drives XGMII Idle characters (xgmii_txd = 32'h0707_0707, 
   15:                   xgmii_txc = 4'b1111).
   16:                2. Cycle 1 (Start of Frame /S/):
   17:                   Replaces the first byte of the Preamble in Lane 0 with the 
   18:                   XGMII Start control code 0xFB (xgmii_txd = 32'h5555_55FB, 
   19:                   xgmii_txc = 4'b0001).
   20:                3. Cycle 2 (Preamble + SFD 0xD5):
   21:                   Places the Start Frame Delimiter (0xD5) in Lane 3 
   22:                   (xgmii_txd = 32'hD555_5555, xgmii_txc = 4'b0000) to match 
   23:                   Xilinx 10G PCS/PMA and xgmii_rx_parser lane ordering.
   24:                4. Payload Cycles & Dynamic Termination (/T/):
   25:                   Streams all Ethernet payload words (xgmii_txc = 4'b0000) 
   26:                   until 'mac_valid' de-asserts at the end of the packet, then 
   27:                   appends the XGMII Terminate control code 0xFD followed by 
   28:                   Idle (xgmii_txd = 32'h0707_07FD, xgmii_txc = 4'b1111) and 
   29:                   enforces a 3-cycle (12-Byte) Inter-Packet Gap (IPG).
   30: ===========================================================================
   31: */
   32: 
   33: module xgmii_tx_formatter (
   34:     input  wire        clk,
   35:     input  wire        rst_n,
   36:     input  wire [31:0] mac_data,
   37:     input  wire        mac_valid,
   38:     output reg  [31:0] xgmii_txd,
   39:     output reg  [3:0]  xgmii_txc
   40: );
   41: 
   42:     localparam IDLE     = 2'd0;
   43:     localparam ACTIVE   = 2'd1;
   44:     localparam IPG_WAIT = 2'd2;
   45: 
   46:     reg [1:0]  state;
   47:     reg [15:0] count;
   48: 
   49:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   50:         if (!rst_n) begin
   51:             state     <= IDLE;
   52:             count     <= 16'd0;
   53:             xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   54:             xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   55:         end else begin
   56:             case (state)
   57:                 IDLE: begin
   58:                     if (mac_valid) begin
   59:                         state     <= ACTIVE;
   60:                         count     <= 16'd1;
   61:                         // Cycle 1: Inject XGMII Start /S/ (0xFB) in Lane 0
   62:                         xgmii_txd <= {mac_data[31:8], 8'hFB};
   63:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b0001;
   64:                     end else begin
   65:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   66:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   67:                     end
   68:                 end
   69: 
   70:                 ACTIVE: begin
   71:                     if (mac_valid) begin
   72:                         count <= count + 16'd1;
   73:                         if (count == 16'd1 && mac_data == 32'h5555_55D5) begin
   74:                             // Cycle 2: Align SFD (0xD5) to XGMII Lane 3 [31:24]
   75:                             xgmii_txd <= 32'hD555_5555;
   76:                             xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   77:                         end else begin
   78:                             // Cycles 3..N: Pure Ethernet Frame (MAC + IP + UDP + Payload + FCS)
   79:                             xgmii_txd <= mac_data;
   80:                             xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   81:                         end
   82:                     end else begin
   83:                         // End of Packet: Inject XGMII Terminate /T/ (0xFD) in Lane 0 + 3 Idles
   84:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_07FD;
   85:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   86:                         state     <= IPG_WAIT;
   87:                         count     <= 16'd0;
   88:                     end
   89:                 end
   90: 
   91:                 IPG_WAIT: begin
   92:                     // Enforce minimum 12-Byte (3-cycle) Inter-Packet Gap (IPG)
   93:                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   94:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   95:                     if (count == 16'd2) begin
   96:                         state <= IDLE;
   97:                         count <= 16'd0;
   98:                     end else begin
   99:                         count <= count + 16'd1;
  100:                     end
  101:                 end
  102: 
  103:                 default: state <= IDLE;
  104:             endcase
  105:         end
  106:     end
  107: 
  108: endmoduleLampiran F — Konfigurasi IP yang tersedia dalam ZIP
Ini pemeriksaan isi XCI yang dilampirkan, bukan permintaan XPR/XDC. Read latency, width conversion dan clock harus konsisten dengan pemakai RTL.
